description: Turn product ideas into clear PRDs, build-ready specifications, and phased delivery plans.

defaultPrompt: Turn this product idea into a build-ready PRD.
Improve this PRD and expose missing requirements.

interface.longDescription: ChatPRD Product Manager helps founders, product managers, and coding agents turn rough ideas into precise product requirements. It covers the problem, users, goals, non-goals, user flows, screens, data model, APIs, edge cases, success metrics, milestones, and implementation handoff for tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, and similar builders.
